request: Add an async `get_account_by_email_ci` to the users CRUD that looks up an account by email, case-insensitive.

summary.result_text:
I added `get_account_by_email_ci` to `lnbits/core/crud/users.py`, but I haven't run any checks on it. The lint command (`ruff check`) needed approval and didn't run, and I ran no Makefile targets or tests.

**What it does:** `get_account_by_email_ci(email, active_only=True, conn=None)` lowercases the input and matches it against `LOWER(email)`. It returns `Account | None` and applies the same `activated` filter as the neighbouring lookups. An empty string returns `None` without querying. I modelled it on `get_account_by_username`.

**Not exported:** I did not add it to `lnbits/core/crud/__init__.py`. Say if you want it exported there.

**Existing problem:** `lnbits/core/crud/__init__.py` imports `get_account_by_email` from `.users`, and `decorators.py` and the auth/user services call it. But `users.py` has no definition of it, so importing `lnbits.core.crud` will likely fail with an `ImportError`. I didn't touch that, since it's outside this task. It may mean the repo is in a half-finished state, or that the function lives somewhere I didn't find. I can add or fix it if you want.

Files touched: `lnbits/core/crud/users.py`
